reason: This plugin is a user-facing utility for DeepSeek Harness that enables LAN access to the web interface and improves HTTP compatibility by binding the GUI host to `0.0.0.0` and injecting a small UUID polyfill, while also providing a LAN-facing privileged API toggle that can expand attack surface.

summaries.zh: 在不修改官方代码的前提下，本插件用于将 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面绑定到 `0.0.0.0`，使其可供局域网机器访问，并对 HTTP 场景注入 `crypto.randomUUID` 补丁以保持功能可用。
summaries.en: This plugin enables LAN access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI by binding it to `0.0.0.0` and adds a `crypto.randomUUID` compatibility injection so HTTP-origin API behavior works without modifying shipped DSH code.

capabilities: LAN network exposure by patching the web GUI host binding to 0.0.0.0.
HTTP compatibility injection of a crypto.randomUUID polyfill in the served page.
Remote privileged API access can be enabled for LAN clients via default `allowRemotePrivileged` behavior.

reasons.code: Plugin feature table states it rebinds DeepSeek Harness Web GUI to 0.0.0.0 so other LAN machines can reach it.
Feature notes describe adding a `crypto.randomUUID` polyfill into `index.html` so `/api` RPC works on non-secure HTTP LAN origins.
Notes document that privileged `/api` methods (settings/credentials/agent presets) are reachable from trusted LAN hosts by default unless configured off.
Notes explicitly warn the plugin intentionally exposes a remote-code-execution surface on the network.

capabilities: LAN network exposure by patching the web GUI host binding to 0.0.0.0.
HTTP compatibility injection of a crypto.randomUUID polyfill in the served page.
Remote privileged API access can be enabled for LAN clients via default `allowRemotePrivileged` behavior.
